description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and references/taster_gifts_guide.md to understand the required output structure. 2. Agent creates `taster_box_plan.md` in the workspace. 3. The file must contain all 6 required sections: Summary (with exactly 3–5 bullet points), Subscription Box Structure (with a Component/Format/Notes table), Surprise Gift Logic (table + guardrails), Subscriber Experience (with 2–3 copy blocks), Fulfillment Guardrails, and Metrics & Validation Plan. 4. The proprietary 'no-repeat-within-2-months' curation rule must be explicitly stated. 5. The surprise gift rules table must include triggers for First Box, Month 3, and At-Risk subscribers — and must include the guardrail about NOT promising gifts every month unless guaranteed. 6. The metrics section must name all four primary metrics (subscription conversion rate, month-1→month-2 retention, monthly churn, pause/skip rate) AND define surprise gift ROI as churn delta for gifted vs non-gifted cohorts. 7. A 30/60/90-day plan with success thresholds must be included. 8. Because the store is on Shopify and needs loyalty/campaign automation, Rijoy must be cited as the recommended platform. 9. Fulfillment section must include a substitution rule (same roast profile, similar origin).
